title: Plant Station R13 Design Change and Verification
scope_note: R13 design-change review against preserved R12 mechanical geometry. Digital geometry evidence is recorded separately from physical acceptance, which remains open where stated.
history_limit: This is the first located PLANT-TR-001 source. No earlier same-family design-review PDF is evidenced; R12 is a supporting mechanical baseline, not a prior PLANT-TR-001 issue.

history.description: Section 02 / page 5: separate 10 mm tube and 8 mm pump-wire routes, with the pump-wire crossover at z81, are retained where explicitly stated. No R12 PLANT-TR-001 issue has been found.

Sections 01-03 / pages 4-6: first located design-review issue. Section 01 records four main parts; Section 02 removes the clip/shelf/pilot and old holder bores/pads, revises local radii and feet, and lowers the sensor entry to z64; Section 03 records revision-specific digital verification evidence and the related low-entry limitation.

sections.title: Design change and verification
sections.subtitle: 14 September 2026 / Supersedes R12 mechanical geometry / Units: mm

blocks.text: Five browser annotations implemented.
Four main enclosure parts; selected knob and fit coupons are separate.
The illustration is generated appearance guidance; the exported CAD remains dimensional authority.
Body: 207 x 100 x 158 mm. Overall roof height: 161 mm. Changes are local to the combined body and planter; fascia, roof and knob interfaces are retained.
1. Clip: removed the separate hose clip, its shelf and shelf pilot. The tower has no retained clip attachment point.
2. Hose route appearance: enlarged vertical outside rounds from R1 to R7 and added R3 top rounds to the supported riser.
Editorial notation: R1, R7, R3 and R2 in this section denote radii in millimetres, not Plant design revisions.
Separate 10 mm tube and 8 mm pump-wire bores remain.
Physical tubing bend radius is still unknown.
3. Screw block: replaced the rounded lower support profile with full feet and added concave R2 floor roots on both sides. Material probes verify the feet are filled.
Audited cavity floor/vertical, shell rim, upper webs, board roots/tips, USB chamfers, sump/planter/lip and riser edge treatments; no further inverted root treatment identified in the source review.
4. Battery: removed both old holder bores and underlying unused pad/pilot features.
The integrated saddle and tie tunnel remain.
5. Sensor lead: entry centre lowered from z128 to z64; its 8 mm hole starts at the z60 sump rim. A local skirt relief avoids a cable clash.
This interpretation targets the separate sensor entry, not the pump-wire crossover, which remains at z81.
Nominal datum: x right, y rear, z up; fascia faces forward. All new radii and route clearances are design choices, not measured component values.

Export checks: 19 STL meshes, 19 single-solid STEP parts, four-solid assembly; six main-part pair intersections; 61 sampled planter lift positions from 0 to 120 mm. See accompanying JSON records for measured results and hashes.

Checks include closed meshes, consistent winding, two faces per edge, no degenerate faces, positive volumes, STEP validity, matching bounds/volumes, feature sections and positive/negative solid probes. Sampled lift checks do not constitute a continuous swept-volume proof.

Physical fit, slicing, support removal, loads, water tightness, cable bend/retention and powered operation remain unverified. Full mesh self-intersection checking has not been performed. The local CadQuery runtime may exit 1 during shutdown even after assertions pass; distinguish that from any assertion traceback.
The low sensor entry is not a seal or approved fill level. Validate capillary, splash and drain-back behaviour before wet operation.
Existing electrical uncertainties and provisional third-control role remain unchanged.

Deliverables: editable build.py, STL/STEP exports, assembly STEP, actual CAD images and sections, AI illustration/prompt, viewer, this review and the separate customer-format kit instructions. R12 is preserved.
